sources.title: Discharges to surface water and groundwater: environmental permits
sources.facts: Updated 20 April 2026; explains when permits are needed and standard or bespoke routes.
sources.guard: Guidance is not a permit, operator status, discharge acceptance, compliance result or site-specific risk assessment.

sources.title: Groundwater source protection zones (SPZs)
sources.facts: SPZ1, SPZ2 and SPZ3 show pollution-risk zones around groundwater sources.
sources.guard: SPZ geometry is non-statutory risk evidence and not a parcel decision, pollution finding, permit refusal or exact abstraction protection outcome.

sources.title: Apply for an environmental permit
sources.facts: Published 12 February 2026 and updated 26 February 2026; online application route covers activities that may pollute or increase flood risk.
sources.guard: Application availability or submission is not permit grant, legal-operator status, compliance or planning permission.

sources.title: Reservoir flood maps: when and how to use them
sources.facts: Updated 9 December 2025; maps model dry-day and wet-day dam-failure scenarios.
sources.guard: Modelled maximum extent is not probability for an individual property, not Flood Zone 2 or 3 and must not be used in isolation.

sources.title: Flood risk assessments: applying for planning permission
sources.facts: FRA guidance requires consideration of current and future risk from all sources and suitability of datasets.
sources.guard: Map products do not replace a site-specific FRA, functional-floodplain evidence, local SFRA or model review.

sources.title: Check the long term flood risk for an area in England
sources.facts: Service covers rivers and sea, surface water, reservoirs and groundwater where data is available.
sources.guard: Service does not state whether an individual property will flood and is not suitable on its own for development planning.

sources.title: Water supply asset discharges: consents, permits and risk assessments
sources.facts: Updated 23 June 2026; some water-supply asset discharges need section 166 consent or an environmental permit.
sources.guard: Guidance and risk-assessment steps are not consent, permit grant, operating compliance or evidence of no environmental effect.

sources.title: Flood risk activities: environmental permits
sources.facts: Works on or near main rivers, flood defences, floodplains or sea defences may require permission.
sources.guard: Proximity or map intersection does not prove permit requirement, exemption eligibility, consent outcome or lawful commencement.
